name: cockpit
description: A live pane for what surrounds the session: cost, context, git, PR checks, your own gauges, an inbox for messages from other sessions, and an away-mode summary

gauges.title: Custom gauges (JSON)
gauges.description: JSON array of {label, kind: "mcp"|"command"|"http", server+tool+args | argv | url, every (seconds), pick (dotted path, or /regex/)}. Empty or [] shows only the built-in gauges.

refreshSeconds.title: Built-in refresh (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often git and PR checks refresh. At least 5.

quietInbox.title: Quiet inbox
quietInbox.description: Consume messages from other sessions so they reach the Inbox section and a toast, not the transcript or the model.

awayMode.title: Away mode
awayMode.description: When a turn ends and you seem away, send a short summary.

awayMinutes.title: Away after (minutes idle)
awayMinutes.description: Idle time that counts as away.

awaySummary.title: Away summary
awaySummary.description: answer: the first 300 characters of the final answer (free). haiku: a one-line Haiku summary (one small model call per away turn).

presenceServer.title: Presence MCP server
presenceServer.description: Optional. An MCP server whose tool answers with your idle time in seconds. Empty reads macOS idle time with ioreg; elsewhere you count as present.

presenceTool.title: Presence MCP tool
presenceTool.description: Tool name on the presence server.

presenceArgs.title: Presence tool arguments (JSON)
presenceArgs.description: JSON object passed to the presence tool.

awayServer.title: Away MCP server
awayServer.description: Optional. Send the summary through this MCP server (a chat bot, say) instead of a terminal notification.

awayTool.title: Away MCP tool
awayTool.description: Tool name on the away server.

awayArgs.title: Away tool arguments (JSON)
awayArgs.description: JSON object; any string containing {{text}} gets the summary. Empty means {"text": "{{text}}"}.
